intro: Gameweek 6, gentlemen, and Man City went to Anfield and won 3-0, which is rude. Chelsea put five past Bournemouth, Coventry beat Newcastle 4-1 and Arsenal got past Leeds 2-1. Brahmes top-scored with 55 and Jack propped up the board with 29. Ben's 49 put him top on 308, one place up, while Asher slipped to second on 305 after a 39. Jonny is third on 272, Josh dropped to fourth, and Louie and Brahmes both climbed a spot. Jack fell two places. The title race is ON, and it's three points wide.
motw: Brahmes, 55 points, and nobody else was close. Cunha, Rogers and N.Jackson all returned and four of his six scorers hit seven or more. Evanilson scored in a 5-1 defeat, which is the sort of luck you can't buy. Up a place to sixth. Keep it quiet, gentlemen, he'll only get ideas.
stinker: Jack managed 29 points, and his Bournemouth pair, Rayan and Petrović, shipped five between them. Petrović got 0 and Rayan 2. O'Reilly picked up 5 for a Man City clean sheet from the bench. Down two places to seventh. Quantum of Tzolis, and Tzolis scored nothing again.
bench: Asher left 11 points on the bench, and nine of them were Donnarumma. The keeper got a clean sheet, six saves and a bonus point for Man City. Martinez started and managed 3. Asher is only three points off top. The bench is where points go to die, and this one got a headstone.
bench_jam: Jamie, this one is for you. Castagne didn't play, so Rúben came on and banked 6 points from a Man City clean sheet. Not exactly a worldie, but a sub that works is a sub that works. Good bit of luck in a bad week.
red_card: Horníček in goal for Newcastle, who lost 4-1 at Coventry. Four conceded, two saves and 0 points. Jamie owns him, so he gets the red card. Whoever owns him should say sorry to the lads.
gloves: Horníček again, with four goals conceded and two saves at Coventry. Jamie owns him, which is apparently the way the cards fall. Hands up if you're surprised. Nobody? No, thought not. The gloves go to the man who needs them most.

xi.384: Donnarumma kept a clean sheet for Man City, made six saves and picked up 9. Asher left him on the bench. Absolutely brutal.
xi.115: De Cuyper scored and kept a clean sheet for Brighton, with three bonus points. That's 15 points in 67 minutes. A proper set and forget.
xi.8: Calafiori scored for Arsenal and got 9 points. Ben's defender does the business again.
xi.504: Vuskovic kept a clean sheet for Brighton and made 15 defensive contributions. Ben had a good week. Not many defenders earn 8 for graft alone.
xi.236: Dewsbury-Hall had a goal, an assist and three bonus points for 13. Jonny's captain material this week.
xi.428: Cunha got an assist and 14 defensive contributions at Old Trafford. 10 points for Brahmes. Played himself into form.
xi.399: Cherki scored in Man City's 3-0 win at Liverpool. 10 points for Jonny, who is third. Hospital ball.
xi.40: Rogers scored in Chelsea's 5-1 win and got 9 points. Brahmes owned a lot of the good stuff this week.
xi.452: Bruno G. played 27 minutes, scored and got three bonus points for 9. Louie couldn't have asked for more from a cameo. Absolute scenes.
xi.165: João Pedro scored twice for Chelsea in 71 minutes and got 12. Josh's best player of the week by some distance.
xi.166: N.Jackson scored for Villa in a 2-2 with Brentford and got three bonus points. 9 for Brahmes. Another one in his pocket.
